assets.description: Employee contracts stored in the internal HR system
Salary details stored in the internal HR system
Performance reviews stored in the internal HR system
Monthly payroll data export sent to the external accounting firm
Former employees' records retained in the HR system for several years

vulnerabilities.description: Managers can access their entire team's records, increasing the risk of overly broad internal access to sensitive contract data.
Salary details are accessible to HR staff across the office network without mention of role-based access controls limiting who can view them.
Performance reviews are accessible to managers, creating a risk that sensitive appraisal data could be viewed beyond its intended audience.
Payroll export is transmitted to an external third party, introducing risk if the transfer channel or the accounting firm's security posture is not controlled.
Former employees' records are retained for several years with no described mechanism to restrict or audit access to stale sensitive data.

threats.description: A malicious insider HR staff member accesses and exfiltrates employee contract data from the office network.
A manager deliberately accesses salary details of team members beyond their own team, exploiting broad access permissions.
An external attacker compromises the office network and gains unauthorised access to salary details stored in the HR system.
A manager accesses and leaks performance reviews of employees outside their own team by exploiting insufficient access restrictions.
An external attacker intercepts the monthly payroll export in transit to the accounting firm and obtains sensitive salary data.
A compromised or malicious employee at the external accounting firm misuses the payroll data received each month.

octave_profile.access: via application (accounting firm's systems receiving the export)

threats.description: An HR staff member accidentally sends the payroll export to an incorrect recipient, exposing sensitive salary data.
An external attacker targets the HR system to access retained records of former employees whose credentials or data could be leveraged for fraud.
A malicious insider accesses and modifies retained records of former employees to falsify employment history or salary information.
